rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-09-06

rows.author: A019
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A DRUG REHABILITATION CENTER IN THE CITY OF SAN CARLOS, PROVINCE OF NEGROS OCCIDENTAL TO BE KNOWN AS 'THE CARLOS CITY CRISIS MANAGEMENT CENTER' AND TO PROVIDE FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on DANGEROUS DRUGS since 2004-09-06

rows.author: D007
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE INSTALLATION AND MAINTENANCE OF CHECKPOINTS
rows.abstract: The bill authorizes the maintenance of checkpoints only under exceptional circumstances such as when there is a clear and present danger to national security, public safety or public health or when the survival of the organized government is in the balance or when the lives and safety of the people are in grave peril.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2004-09-06

rows.author: D024
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NUMBER 7227, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'BASES CONVERSION AND DEVELOPMENT ACT OF 1992' AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NUMBER 7917, ADJUSTING THE ALLOCATION OF REVENUES FROM THE SALE, LEASE, JOINT-VENTURE AGREEMENTS AND OTHER TRANSACTIONS INVOLVING MILITARY BASES RESERVATIONS, ALLOCATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill provides for a) the inclusion of the proceeds of the sale, lease, joint-venture agreements involving military bases and reservations as part of the capitalization of the Conversion Authority; b) rationalization of the funding scheme of the Conversion Authority; c) equitable redistribution of the proceeds from transactions involving military bases, among others.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASES CONVERSION since 2004-09-06

rows.author: D024
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE TEACHING-LEARNING OF THE MAJOR CORDILLERA LANGUAGES, NAMELY, BAGUIO ILOKANO, IFUGAO, INIBALOI, KANKANAI, KALINGA, ISNAG, TINGUIAN, AND IFONTOK, AS OPTIONAL SUBJECTS WITH ACCREDITED UNITS IN THE TERTIARY LEVEL OF COLLEGES AND UNIVERSITIES IN THE CORDILLERA ADMINISTRATIVE REGION
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2004-09-06

rows.author: D024
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ESTABLISH A HIGHER STANDARD OF PROMOTION AND PROTECTION OF THE RIGHTS AND WELFARE OF FILIPINO OVERSEAS SEAFARERS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Overseas Seafarers Act.\" For the protection of seafarers, the bill prescribes the recruitment and placement policies of the government, the duties of recruitment and placement services, the penalties for illegal recruitment, the conditions of employment and social welfare benefits, disciplinary and dispute settlement procedures and post employment and repatriation policies.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on OVERSEAS WORKERS AFFAIRS since 2005-01-12

rows.author: D024
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR MAXIMUM PERFORMANCE IN REVENUE COLLECTION THROUGH THE GRANTING OF SPECIAL INCENTIVES AND REWARDS FOR EXEMPLARY SERVICE AND THROUGH LATERAL ATTRITION IN REVENUE-GENERATING AGENCIES OF GOVERNMENT AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The measure aims to grant incentives and rewards to collection officials/officers/employees who render outstanding service while upholding the highest ethical standards. It allows expeditious action against non-performing officials/officers/empoloyees by removing them from their positions if they do not meet set standards.
rows.status: Substituted by HB02996

committee_action.action: Approved by the Committee on 2005-01-25

rows.author: D024
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE NATIONAL RAILWAY AUTHORITY TO ACCELERATE THE DEVELOPMENT OF A NATIONAL RAILWAY SYSTEM, PRESCRIBING ITS POWERS, FUNCTIONS AND DUTIES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"National Railways Act of 2004.\" The National Railways Authority (NRA) shall formulate and adopt a comprehensive national railways development plan and implement the same. The NRA shall control, develop, construct, operate and maintain the railway facilities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on RAILWAYS AND RO-RO SYSTEMS since 2006-05-30

rows.author: C105
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 4 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8550, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'PHILIPPINE FISHERIES CODE OF 1998'
rows.abstract: The bill allows subsistence fishermen to use bigger vessels to encourage them to embark on bigger undertakings and, ultimately, improve their standard of living.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AQUACULTURE AND FISHERIES RESOURCES since 2005-01-12

rows.author: D029
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE BENEFITS OF BARANGAY OFFICIALS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 393 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991, CREATING A NATIONAL AUGMENTATION FUND, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill increases the monthly honoraria granted to barangay officials from P1,000 to P2,000 for the punong barangay, P1,800 for the sangguniang barangay members and P1,500 for the barangay treasurer, secretary and tanods.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-09-06

rows.author: D029
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ANNUAL AUTOMATIC INCREASE IN THE AMOUNT OF PENSION PAID TO ALL RETIRED GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The measure grants retired government employees an automatic yearly increase in their pension based on the annual rate of increase of the national cost of living index.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-09-06

rows.author: D029
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9164 TO EXTEND THE TERMS OF OFFICE OF BARANGAY OFFICIALS AND RESET THE DATE OF BARANGAY ELECTIONS
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to hold a synchronized barangay and sangguniang kabataan (SK) elections on the 2nd Monday of May 2007 simultaneous with the local and national elections.  Subsequent synchronized barangay and SK elections shall be held every three years thereafter.
rows.status: Substituted by HB03742

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 2004-09-07

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE, FOOD & FISHERIES since 2004-09-07

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE, FOOD & FISHERIES since 2004-09-07

rows.author: A035
rows.title_full: AN ACT UPGRADING THE MONTHLY BENEFITS OF WORLD WAR II VETERANS, THEIR SPOUSES, AND UNMARRIED MINOR CHILDREN
rows.abstract: The bill proposes that the monthly pension of veterans be based on age, to wit: a) from 75 to 79 - P6,700; b) from 80 to 89 - P7,000; and c) from 90 and above - P8,700.
rows.status: Transmitted to the Committee on Appropriations on 2006-06-06

committee_action.action: Transmitted to the Committee on Appropriations on 2006-06-06

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A HEALTH CENTER IN EACH BARANGAY OF THE SECOND CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICT OF THE PROVINCE OF SAMAR, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-09-07

rows.author: A035
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING PROTECTION TO JOURNALISTS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Journalists' Protection Act of 2004.\"  To protect the welfare of journalists, the bill seeks to grant journalists a comprehensive benefits and compensation package.  It also provides for their working conditions.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 2004-09-07

rows.author: A035
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING A MARITIME TRANSPORT SAFETY COUNCIL IN EVERY PORT OF ORIGIN THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY, PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: \"Maritime Transport Safety Act of 2004.\" The bill prescribes the powers, functions and organizational structure of the Council and penalizes negligent and abusive government officials and employees and owners and unseaworthy passenger ships and transport vessels.
rows.status: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2006-08-16

committee_action.action: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2006-08-16

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-09-07

rows.author: A061
rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE AUTOMATIC DEDUCTION OF 30% FROM EVERY TAXPAYER'S PAYMENT FOR FOREIGN DEBT SERVICING AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: To prevent the ballooning of our foreign debts, the bill authorizes the earmarking of 30% of the tax payments to pay our foreign debts.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2004-09-07

rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE TITLING AND REGISTRATION OF ALL SCHOOL SITES IN THE NAME OF THE MUNICIPALITY WHERE THEY ARE LOCATED AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The bill directs the Department of Justice to promulgate the guidelines for the titling and registration of all school sites in the name of the municipality where the school is located.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2004-09-07

rows.author: C126
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE NEW LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE 442, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: New Labor Code of the Philippines
rows.abstract: \"New Labor Code of the Philippines.\" The bill seeks to cover within the ambit of the Code not only workers from the formal sector but also those from the informal and public sectors, the kasambahay or household helpers, persons with disability, and overseas Filipino workers or migrant workers.  It also seeks to ensure that the Code is child-friendly and gender sensitive.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2004-09-07

rows.author: D062
rows.title_full: AN ACT REMOVING RESTRICTIONS ON THE TRANSFER AND OTHER CONVEYANCES OF TITLES ACQUIRED THROUGH FREE PATENT, AMENDING COMMONWEALTH ACT NO. 141, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE PUBLIC LAND ACT, AND OTHER PERTINENT LAWS, AND OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to update the obsolete provisions of the Public Land Act and facilitate the mass titling of public alienable and disposable lands in the Philippines. Among others, it provides for a) the reduction of the period of cultivation and occupation from 30 years to 10 years; b) the issuance of free patents without payment of oustanding taxes; c) extends free patents to residential, commercial and industrial lands.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2004-09-07

rows.author: E018
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL FACILITY FOR IRRADIATION TECHNOLOGY AT THE PHILIPPINE NUCLEAR RESEARCH INSTITUTE AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: \"Irradiation Technology Act of 2004.\" The bill defines irradiation as a physical method of treating food and medical products by exposing them to gamma rays or electrons from radioisotopes and electron machine. The proposed facility shall be tasked to provide proper irradiation facility for commercial and large scale practical applications.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY since 2004-09-07

rows.author: E018
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A SENIOR CITIZENS  TECHNOLOGY AND LIVELIHOOD CENTER IN EVERY BARANGAY IN THE FOURTH DISTRICT OF ILOILO AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on POPULATION AND FAMILY RELATIONS since 2004-09-07

rows.author: E002
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE USE OF CELLULAR PHONE AND OTHER SIMILAR TELECOMMUNICATION DEVICES BY DRIVERS OF PUBLIC UTILITY VEHICLES (PUVs) AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill prohibits the use of handheld cellular phone or any similar telecommunication device by any motorist while driving a public utility vehicle, including public utility buses and public utility jeepneys.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2005-08-15

rows.author: C069
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 145 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1997
rows.abstract: The bill seesk to increase the tax rates of all tabacco products by P1.00 per pack in order to capture incremental revenues from the low tax tier brands also.
rows.status: Substituted by HB03174

rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING PROVINCES, CITIES AND MUNICIPALITIES TO MAKE LOANS USING THE SPECIAL EDUCATION FUND AS COLLATERAL, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE SECTION 272 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991

rows.title_full: AN ACT CONSTITUTING LOCAL TREASURERS AS AGENTS OF THE COMMISSIONER OF INTERNAL REVENUE, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE SECTION 12 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, PROVIDING FOR AN INCENTIVE SCHEME FOR THE COLLECTION BY LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS OF NATIONAL TAXES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill authorizes local treasurers to collect national internal revenue taxes for remittance to the National Treasury. As an incentive, it allows local government units to retain 50% of the collection target excess.

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING ALL INDEPENDENT POWER PRODUCERS, GENERATION COMPANIES AND/OR ENERGY RESOURCE DEVELOPERS TO REMIT THE AMOUNT THEY ARE REQUIRED TO SET ASIDE AS FINANCIAL BENEFIT TO HOST COMMUNITIES DIRECTLY TO THE LATTER
rows.title_short: Requiring All Independent Power Producers, Generation Companies and/or Energy Resource Developers to Remit the Amount They Are Required to Set Aside as Financial Benefit to Hose Communities Directly to the Latter
rows.abstract: In order to expedite the remittance of the financial benefit (one centavo per kilowatt hour of the total electricity sales) that independent power products, generation companies and energy resource developers are required to set aside for the affected host communities, the bill directs said entities to remit the benefits directly to the communities concerned.
